# CommunitySearch

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Community` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class CommunitySearch
```

The one search box: `#tag`, `@user` and plain words, combined with AND. The text is the only source of truth, so clicking a tag chip, a tile's owner or a tag link just edits the text with [`CommunitySearch.Toggle()`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.CommunitySearch.md#m-toggle-system-string-system-string).

### Parse(string?) { #m-parse-system-string }

```csharp
public static CommunityQuery Parse(string? text);
```

Splits the box's text on whitespace into tags, owners and words. A lone `#` or `@` is ignored.

**Parameters**

- `text` (`string?`) - What the user typed; null reads as empty.

**Returns.** The tags, owners and words the text names.

### Toggle(string?, string) { #m-toggle-system-string-system-string }

```csharp
public static string Toggle(string? text, string token);
```

Adds `token` to the text when it is not there, removes it when it is, and leaves single spaces.

**Parameters**

- `text` (`string?`) - The box's text.
- `token` (`string`) - The token, such as `#pets` or `@alice`. Compared ignoring case.

**Returns.** The text with the token added or removed.
